eyes.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a NEW independent paired-eyes RGBA game portrait layer, transparent 1024x1024 local drawing canvas. It will later be uniformly reduced as a whole to fit a fixed face; draw clearly at this local scale.
Image 1 is the unchanged target face/skin compatibility reference only; Image 2 is only a soft Chinese gongbi and light-watercolor brushwork reference. Do not extract or reuse pixels from either image.
Draw a matched pair of complete natural feminine eyes, serene forward gaze, gently open short-to-moderate almond shapes, low-saturation gray-brown irises, deep brown pupils, ivory eye whites, tiny soft catchlight. Complete upper and lower eye rims with delicate local eyelid fold and softly dissolving local warm shadow, continuous alpha. Preserve full eye anatomy and quiet volume.
Composition: Only the two eyes, horizontally level, on an otherwise empty transparent canvas. The pupil centers should be approximately (330,512) and (694,512), with each eye opening about 220px wide and 65px high. This anatomical proportion matters more than exact source coordinates: medium-short eye length and a generous natural nose-bridge gap. Two matching eyes in one layer.
Visual style: refined thin warm-gray-brown ink lines, pale gouache-watercolor texture, low contrast hand-painted edges, same light and subtle detail density as Image 2. Compatible with pale warm target cheeks RGB(240,216,203), no hard warm/cool skin boundary.
Critical: Natural bare eyes, no cosmetics. No winged eyeliner, no extra stroke outside the anatomical outer corner, no long raised tail, no thick black upper lash line, no dramatic eyelashes. No stylized narrow fox eyes. Do not make them glossy 3D or photographic makeup.
Transparency: Keep only eye pigment and very local soft eyelid shadows fading into full alpha, never an opaque patch of skin. The bridge between the eyes and the canvas outside the local brush marks must be completely transparent. No broad veil, large blurry halo, beige rectangle, face silhouette, white matte, black backing or painted checkerboard.
No eyebrows, nose, mouth, full face, hair, head, body, text, labels or atlas. Newly paint this pair from scratch.

Thin airy brows with softened inner heads and fine feathered tails, medium low pigment density, elegant natural human asymmetry. No eyes, eyelids, lashes, nose, mouth, face, hair, head, body, text, labels or atlas. Newly paint this pair from scratch.
